name: 46819-burst1024-dsv2lite-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node, nothing else on the card.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM: sparse MoE with multi-head latent attention, 27 layers, 16 query heads, hidden 2048, kv_lora_rank 512, head_size 576, v_head_dim 128, 64 routed + 2 shared experts with top-6 routing, bf16, 15.7B total / ~2.4B activated (~31 GB).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1000, no warmup and no cooldown, bounded at 1000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap. All 1000 arrive at t=0, so the run is a single wave and every request is scored.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, FIXED 1024 prompt tokens / 1024 output tokens (min = max = nominal on both), `request_format: plain` so no chat template is applied, `temperature: 0.0`, static seed 46819. Output length is forced by construction: guidellm sets `max_tokens` and `ignore_eos=True` on every request. Under `plain` the wire length equals the declared length exactly, so the posted prompt is 1024 tokens and any other count is drift worth investigating.
purpose: A mid-size sparse expert chat assistant producing 1024-token replies to 1024-token prompts for 1000 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Read by a flat line reader as well as by a YAML parser, so every
# key must be top-level and every value must fit on one line with no inline `#`.

model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# Must be passed. On SM90 this engine ranks the compiled MLA paths ahead of TRITON_MLA, so
# without this line the run serves a different backend and completes happily.
attention-backend: TRITON_MLA

tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.92
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
